findings.title: Docstring for receive_data is stale and misleading
findings.body:
The new implementation of `receive_data` reassembles COTP DT fragments until the EOT bit is set, but the docstring still describes the old single-frame behavior. This misleads readers about what the function does and how to use it.

Update the docstring to describe fragment reassembly and the EOT-based termination, matching the new implementation.
findings.suggestion:
"""Receive data from client.

        Reassembles COTP DT fragments by reading frames until the EOT
        bit (bit 7 of the third COTP header byte) is set, then returns
        the concatenated payload.
        """

findings.title: Docstring for _build_cotp_cc is stale and misleading
findings.body:
The new implementation of `_build_cotp_cc` includes a TPDU size parameter in the COTP CC PDU, but the docstring still describes the old minimal CC. This misrepresents the function’s behavior and the protocol contract it fulfills.

Update the docstring to explain that the PDU includes the TPDU size parameter so clients know the negotiated maximum segment size and avoid falling back to the ISO 8073 class-0 default of 128 bytes.
findings.suggestion:
"""Build COTP Connection Confirm.

        Includes the TPDU size parameter (0xC0) so clients know the
        negotiated maximum segment size and don't fall back to the
        ISO 8073 class-0 default of 128 bytes.
        """

findings.title: Extracted _build_cotp_cc uses inconsistent formatting for struct.pack
findings.body:
The new `_build_cotp_cc` uses a different struct format string (`">BBBHHB"`) and packing order than the surrounding codebase, which previously used `">BBHHB"` for the base PDU. This inconsistency makes the code harder to read and maintain.

Align the struct format and packing order with the existing style in the file to preserve readability and reduce cognitive overhead.
findings.suggestion:
base_pdu = struct.pack(
            ">BBHHB",
            pdu_length,  # PDU length
            self.COTP_CC,  # PDU type
            0x00,  # Reserved / CDT
            self.dst_ref,  # Destination reference (client's source ref)
            self.src_ref,  # Source reference (our ref)
            0x00,  # Class/option
        )

findings.title: Return value of _build_cotp_cc is inconsistent with surrounding code
findings.body:
The new `_build_cotp_cc` returns `base_pdu + pdu_size_param`, but the old implementation returned `struct.pack(">B", 6) + base_pdu[1:]`. The surrounding code expects the PDU to start with a length byte, which is now missing. This will break callers that rely on the old format.

Reintroduce the length-prefixed PDU to maintain compatibility with the rest of the codebase and the protocol expectations.

summary.problem: Stale docstrings and inconsistent formatting/return values in new COTP logic reduce maintainability and risk breaking protocol compatibility.
summary.done_well: The changes add COTP fragment reassembly, TPDU size negotiation, and clearer parameter handling, improving robustness and client compatibility.
